summary: Mirror the portal images to your disconnected registry and set redhat-developer-hub.global.imageRegistry, a single override for the app, PostgreSQL, OCI plug-in and Ansible Dev Tools sidecar images. It is required even with ImageDigestMirrorSet or ImageTagMirrorSet, because the dynamic plug-in init container ignores cluster mirror config.
questions: What is imageRegistry in the portal Helm chart?
Portal plug-in init container pulls from registry.redhat.io despite mirror
How do I point the portal chart at a mirrored registry?

answer_card.title: Mirrored registry for the portal: imageRegistry
answer_card.answer_md:
Set `redhat-developer-hub.global.imageRegistry` to your mirror (e.g. `mirror.example.com` or `quay.io/<org>`). It overrides the registry for the base app image, PostgreSQL, OCI plug-in artifacts and the Ansible Dev Tools sidecar.

The dynamic plug-in init container **ignores** `ImageDigestMirrorSet`/`ImageTagMirrorSet`, so set `imageRegistry` even if the cluster already redirects `registry.redhat.io`.
